summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds the Update class (prologue, algebra) beside Query; rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py translateUpdate builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] before the empty-request exit and always returns an Update; rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate (mirrors prepareQuery) and leaves the update processor unchanged, since it already passes non-strings through; rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate; test/test_sparql_prepare.py adds tests for the spec workflows. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the new tests and the DAWG/prepareQuery tests are unverified. Black formatting was checked by hand only. One choice to review: the first prologue group is translated twice on non-empty requests (harmless re-binding, avoids an index-based loop). No changes were committed.
